name: eMACS J0127.5-0606 (Hubble)
blurb: eMACS J0127.5-0606, a massive galaxy cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: emacsj012750606-hubble
story: A great crowd of galaxies, this very massive cluster was found by an X-ray survey built on ROSAT All-Sky Survey data. Astronomers search Hubble pictures of clusters like this one for strong gravitational lensing.

claims.text: eMACS J0127.5-0606 is in the eMACS sample of galaxy clusters
eMACS clusters are highly X-ray luminous, very massive clusters
eMACS is an X-ray survey based on ROSAT All-Sky Survey data
HST imaging of eMACS clusters is used to detect strong gravitational lensing
